summary: A work claim reads only the finished runs its seat's queued runs are placed against, directly or through anchors, instead of probing every run its seat's whole queue-move history names; on a production-size copy a seat with 990 moves went from 616 to 52 writer statements a claim, the same as a seat without moves

replay.detail: No graph replay. The queue order is computed from the same claims, and a randomized test checks it is unchanged.

schema.detail: No table, trigger or index change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention, authority or admission rule change.

compatibility.detail: Mixed-version safe: a local read only, with no claim, field, API or wire change. The previous release reads the same store and computes the same queue order.

recovery.detail: Revert the build as usual. An older build probes every named run again and answers the same order.
